name: Atlantic Beach
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Atlantic Beach?
answer_short: Street-legal LSVs yes. Plain golf carts only on a street the city has designated, and that list is not drawn here. In Atlantic Beach, a registered LSV may use roads posted 35 mph or less.

golf_cart.notes: A designated street list is required and is not on this map

rules.rule: A registered, insured LSV may use a road posted 35 mph or less and may cross a faster road at an intersection.
A low-speed vehicle must be registered and may be operated only on the roadways in the city.
A golf cart may use a public road only where the city has designated and signed it. That street list is not drawn on this map, so plain carts stay off public roads here.

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Atlantic Beach?
faq.a: Roads posted 35 mph or less. Registered and insured. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive a regular golf cart in Atlantic Beach?
faq.a: Only on a street the city has designated and signed. That list is not on this map, so plain carts are shown off public roads.

faq.q: Where can I drive an LSV in Atlantic Beach?
faq.a: On roads posted 35 mph or less. Atlantic Beach also says an LSV stays on the roadway and must be registered.
